ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a beloved show, highlighted by Brent “Chippy” Mydland’s signature scratchy keyboards on Not Fade Away.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the tape, calling it an excellent and good‑sounding capture. The performance is fondly remembered, especially the standout moment when Brent Mydland adds his characteristic scratchy texture during Not Fade Away. No major audio flaws are reported, making this a solid addition for fans of the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are upbeat about the show and recording; with limited data the rating leans high but confidence is moderate due to only two reviews.
